message.text: For question 17, I'm checking whether the useMemoQueries.ts file that uses memoServiceClient also covers CRUD mutations like create, update, and delete, not just reads.

q17. web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts; memoServiceClient

This hook file contains the React Query hooks for memo CRUD (`useMemos`/`useInfiniteMemos` for listing, plus create/get/update/delete mutations), all built on top of `memoServiceClient` (imported from `web/src/connect.ts`):

```112:258:/bench/repo/web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts
memoServiceClient.listMemos(...)
...
memoServiceClient.getMemo({ name })
...
memoServiceClient.createMemo({ memo: memoToCreate })
...
memoServiceClient.updateMemo({ ... })
...
memoServiceClient.deleteMemo({ name })
```
